GraphView.title: GraphView

MemberLeft.description: A member left ("Leave and delete my data") or was kicked; their sockets are closed.
MemberLeft.title: MemberLeft

Roots.description: All optional. PUT replaces everything; send empty values to clear.
Roots.title: Roots

SignUp.description:
Sign-up (task 2.6 + profile). Only the birth year is stored; the full date gives an
exact 18+ check.
SignUp.title: SignUp

get.description: The process is up. Does not touch dependencies.
Postgres and Redis answer. Returns 503 if either is down.

delete.description:
Delete my account (task 8.5): identity, profile, roots, snapshots, and my data in every
room, in Postgres and Neo4j. Runs immediately; the design allows up to 24 h.

get.description: Who am I, and how far through onboarding (age gate, consent).

post.description: Record agreement to the data notice (task 2.7). Idempotent.

Sign-up: name, date of birth (18+ check, task 2.6) and hobbies. Adults get an Orbit
profile; for under-18s the sign-in identity is deleted and nothing is stored.

put.description: Replace all roots (task 2.8). Every field is optional.

get.description: My saved graphs from rooms that have expired (task 8.4), newest first.

schema.title: Response List Snapshots Me Snapshots Get

post.description: Create a room; you are its host (task 3.1). The host joins as a player separately.

put.description: Idempotent: sending the same answer twice, or changing it, is fine (task 4.6).

get.description: The room's cards, the same for every member, plus what I already answered (task 4.3).

post.description: I'm done with my deck (task 4.8). The last finisher ends the round early (4.9).

get.description:
The reveal (task 6.6): the same view for every member and the host screen. Every edge
carries its score and reasons (reveal is public to the room).

post.description: Join (task 3.3). Idempotent for existing members. Late joiners can join mid-round.
Host removes a player (and their data); they cannot rejoin this room.
Leave and delete my data (task 3.8): answers, reactions, follows and scores go with it.

Follow or like another player's profile (task 4.7). After the reveal, new follows are
pushed so the graph can animate them (7.4); they don't change scores.
Start the 5-minute round (task 4.4): freeze the deck, tell everyone, schedule the end.
